story_type: empty boat washes ashore, boater found in the surf by the jetties, swimmer and basket hoist
hook: His boat washed ashore 15 minutes later. He was not in it.
narration: His boat washed up on the beach with nobody aboard. He was still out in this surf.
A Port Aransas police officer saw the boat leave the jetties with one man aboard. Fifteen minutes later, it was ashore and empty.
The seas were nine feet, with wind at twenty five miles an hour.
A Coast Guard Dolphin helicopter crew from Corpus Christi was diverted, and they spotted him in the water near the jetties.
A rescue swimmer rides the hoist cable down, gets the survivor into a basket, and the flight mechanic reels them back up.
outcome: The aircrew hoisted the boater from the water, and he was reported in stable condition.
title: Boat washed ashore with nobody aboard
description:
A Coast Guard Sector/Air Station Corpus Christi MH-65 Dolphin aircrew hoists a boater from the surf near the Port Aransas jetties, Texas, after his boat was seen washed ashore with no one aboard, June 16, 2019.

extra_sources.excerpt: CORPUS CHRISTI, Texas — The Coast Guard rescued a boater after his vessel was sighted washed ashore near the Port Aransas jetties Sunday morning.

Sector/Air Station Corpus Christi watchstanders received a call from a Port Aransas Police Department member informing them that a boat with one person aboard had been seen leaving the Port Aransas jetties area and then was sighted washed ashore 15 minutes later with no one aboard.
A Sector/Air Station Corpus Christi MH-65 Dolphin aircrew was diverted and upon arrival to the scene, spotted the boater near the jetties.
The boater was hoisted from the water and transferred to awaiting emergency medical services personnel at Sector/Air Station Corpus Christi.
The weather was reported as 9-foot seas and 25 mph winds.
The boater was reported to be in stable condition.
